thread:
alex: Quick sync — token-cost attribution milestone status? We agreed to land: (1) attribution event schema v2, (2) latency-tag mapping in ingest, (3) cost join table + nightly job. Who's owning each chunk and any blockers?

maria: Eng-platform here. I'll own cost join table + nightly job. PR 482 is up for review. Main blocker: waiting on final event schema fields for token breakdown (need token_type + model_variant). Also need product-analytics signoff on aggregation window. @sam can you confirm?

sam: product-analytics — I can sign off on aggregation window (30s default) but we need to see sample payloads. Can someone paste an example event from current pipeline? :eyes: 

linda: eng-ml — we can include model_variant, but quantization tag is tricky (we don't emit it yet). Quick question: do you need per-invocation quantized flag or per-model default? If per-model is ok I can add a model_metadata feed.

alex: per-invocation would be ideal for accurate unit costs (because runtime differs), but per-model fallback is acceptable for now. Let's do per-invocation optional field 'quantized: boolean' in schema.

owen: data-ingest — we can add latency_tag mapping. Need the list of tags and how to compute end-to-end vs server-only. Propose: latency.total_ms, latency.server_ms, latency.kv_cache_ms. Which ones matter for cost attribution?

maria: For cost, server_ms and kv_cache_ms are most important. total_ms for SLOs. Also add tokens.generated and tokens.prompt.

sam: I'll produce sample payloads by EOD and post to the shared drive: https://drive.internal/redwood/analytics/samples. Will also review PR 482 later today.

linda: I'll open an internal PR to start emitting quantized boolean in the runtime. ETA tomorrow morning. Can we merge schema v2 only after sample verification?

alex: Yes — gating plan: 1) sam posts samples, 2) data-ingest (owen) runs smoke ingest in staging with mappings, 3) eng-platform (maria) runs nightly job dry-run and reports delta vs baseline. If deltas > 2% in cost estimates we pause.

automation-bot: deploy-notify: PR 482 merged into staging at 2157502900 by maria. CI passed :white_check_mark:

maria: Staging run started. Early note: missing tokens.prompt for ~3% of events — looks like older SDK versions. @sam can you confirm SDK rollout plan?

sam: We have a small fleet on 1.2.0 (missing prompt tokens) — rolling 1.2.1 now with the tokens field. Should be done by tomorrow morning.

owen: Running smoke ingest now. Found schema mismatch on latency.kv_cache_ms (sometimes null). Will coerce null->0 for aggregation unless anyone objects.

alex: OK to coerce to 0. Document the coercion in the schema notes. Also add a synthetic test in the ingest to catch nulls.

linda: Quantized flag PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-ml/pulls/97. Runtime emits 'quantized' only when using int8 paths.

sam: samples uploaded: link above. I added one example with quantized=true and one fallback. Will loop back after review.

maria: After today's staging run, nightly job dry-run shows cost estimate delta +0.8% — within threshold. I will schedule a canary rollout to 10% production tomorrow 10:00 PT.

alex: Great. Final asks: (a) owners for post-rollout monitoring (alerts + dashboard?) (b) doc update — schema v2 changelog entry.

maria: I'll own dashboard (latency and cost spike alerts). ow en can you add the alert thresholds in the alert playbook?

owen: Yep — will add thresholds and a runbook entry.

sam: I'll write the changelog and notify support docs.

alex: Thanks all. If no blockers by EOD I'll reconcile action items and close this thread.

maria: :thumbsup:

owen: :rocket:
